name: The Herb Terraces (Dược Điền Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Rain on the Sown Field (Vũ Lạc Bá Điền)
bonuses.rule: while your Grain Rain falls, Lingzhi Spores on the foe do not fade, and each time a spore stack ripens it heals you for 2 % of your health.

story: The founder's gourd, her master's fan and the valley's bell. Nghiêm Linh Chi holds all three; they go to the next valley-mistress together, or the terraces say the year's harvest fails.
